title: Sternbild Roadmap Candidates Pillar
description: Candidates for one pillar: ideas outside the active roadmap registry. A proposed pillar includes a description and an optional fold-in alternative.

pillar.description: Registry prefix of an existing pillar, or the proposed prefix of a new pillar.

proposed.description: True for a pillar that is not in the active registry.

description.description: For a proposed pillar: one sentence on what it holds.

alternative.description: For a proposed pillar: where its candidates could fold in instead.

key.description: Stable lower-case identifier, unique across all candidate files.

title.description: Title Case noun phrase under the docs title rule.

origin.description: cut: a scope cut. plan-idea: an idea in a plan. adjacent-work: from neighboring work. field: from comparable tools.

depends_on.description: Registry feature ids that the candidate builds on.
